brief: MINDTAIL Hindi Short, 9:16 only: fast, punchy, cinematic. Real stock b-roll leads the picture (a cut every 1.5-3 s, literal searches), bold word-synced Hindi captions (pop, 2-3 words, key words in the brand cyan #00E5FF), light motion graphics only where they add information (a number, a comparison, a reveal), a title over the first line at frame 0. Sound is the craft: one CC0 music bed matched to the mood and ducked under the voice, sub-band whoosh on cuts, riser into the reveal, a hit on the payoff, silence before the key line; SFX clearly audible over the bed. No intro, no logo sting, no outro.
topics: relatable youth topics (college, friends, phones, career pressure)
